propositions: Data Center backend has no value-pinning characterization suite, only shape-checking contract tests that would pass with every value wrong, creating asymmetry relative to Cloud where production incidents hardened the pins

DC's separate implementations (_DCOutbound, _DCInbound, _DCSanitizer, _map_local_to_dc_fields) are not exercised through the shared OutboundFieldMapper for WikiTextCodec, leaving regressions undetectable on the DC path

A parametrized characterization suite must pin all DC create-path mapper outputs (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee including defaults and empty-string fallbacks) by exact value, not shape
DC sanitizer boundaries for summary, description and comment must be pinned at-limit and one-over, including truncation suffix marker

DC probe branches must be pinned through a real classifier (classify_probe_response or JiraDataCenterTransport) to reach all four branches, not through FakeTransport which stubs branch=UNREACHABLE unconditionally
DC must be proven to bind its own configured resolved_statuses rather than Cloud's hardcoded set, using a non-default custom set as the discriminator since the defaults are byte-identical
